# FPL Deadline Day

> FPL Deadline Day is a free web app for Fantasy Premier League (FPL) managers. It brings live Premier League scores, a transfer planner, gameweek deadline reminders, player stats and gameweek history into one place. Free, no ads.

Website: https://fpldeadlineday.com

## What it does

- **Live gameweek scores**: Live Premier League scores for every gameweek, grouped by date, with match minute, goals, cards, substitutions and lineups on a pitch view. https://fpldeadlineday.com/live
- **Transfer planner**: Plan FPL transfers several gameweeks ahead on a pitch view, with fixture difficulty, prices, free transfers and chips (Wildcard, Free Hit, Bench Boost, Triple Captain). https://fpldeadlineday.com/transfers
- **Deadline reminders**: Email reminders 24 hours and 2 hours before each gameweek deadline, in the user's local timezone (free account).
- **Player stats and scout**: Sort and search all FPL players by price, form, expected points and total points; compare players side by side; captain picks and differentials. https://fpldeadlineday.com/stats
- **My Team**: The user's current FPL squad with gameweek points, overall rank, bank and team value. https://fpldeadlineday.com/my-team
- **Gameweek history**: Transfer plans, captain picks and chips are saved automatically after each deadline (free account).

## How it works

- Users connect their FPL team with their public FPL Team ID or by pasting the link to their team from fantasy.premierleague.com. No FPL password is needed.
- Data comes from the official Fantasy Premier League API and API-Football.
- The app works on mobile and desktop in any browser. No download required.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://fpldeadlineday.com)
- [Live scores](https://fpldeadlineday.com/live)
- [Player stats](https://fpldeadlineday.com/stats)
- [About](https://fpldeadlineday.com/about)
